title: Wire Playwright E2E tests (13 specs in web/e2e/) into CI — currently never run
description: VERIFIED (re-checked 2026-07-31): web/e2e/ contains 13 Playwright spec files and `npm run test:e2e` is defined, but NO GitHub Actions job executes them. .github/workflows/e2e.yml is misnamed — it is actually the 'Release Build' workflow (docker build+push to ghcr.io on master/release branches) and never invokes playwright. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest, vitest, tsc, and build only. BLOCKER discovered during re-check: e2e/playwright.config.ts targets baseURL http://127.0.0.1:8720 — the REAL FastAPI backend (which serves the built frontend) — and the live-tv/movies/series/search specs need real IPTV data, so a CI job would require IPTV_USER/IPTV_PASS as GitHub secrets (or a full MSW/mock backend). Fix options: (a) add e2e job to ci.yml + IPTV creds as CI secrets; (b) rename e2e.yml to release.yml; (c) document explicitly why E2E is excluded (credential dependency) in README/ROADMAP.

title: Tighten CSP script-src (currently 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval') or document the tradeoff
description: VERIFIED: server/main.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware + web/nginx.conf both set script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'. unsafe-eval is required by hls.js/shaka (WebAssembly/worker eval patterns) and unsafe-inline by React hydration, but this combination defeats most XSS mitigations. Audit whether hls.js/shaka truly need unsafe-eval at runtime (modern versions don't always); if they do, document the accepted risk in SECURITY_AUDIT.md with a rationale instead of leaving it silent.

title: Verify stream preflight latency and CDN behavior at runtime
description: VERIFIED CODE (session 2026-07-31): preflight_stream() in server/routes/stream_core.py opens a short aiohttp connection (status check + 1-byte read) before every live/VOD/remux/transcode/proxy StreamingResponse so dead channels return 502 instead of 200-with-empty-body; results are cached short-TTL (30s success / 5s failure) keyed by URL+Range, with env-configurable STREAM_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT. Unit + route tests added (test_stream.py, test_stream_live.py TestPreflightFailure, test_stream_vod.py TestPreflightFailure) and passing — full backend suite 1379 pass / 17 skip / 3 xfail. Remaining risk: verify against the real provider (iptv-provider.example.com) that (a) channel zapping latency is acceptable with the cache, (b) the 1-byte read does not desync mpegts.js, (c) dead channel IDs (e.g. 250, 1) now return 502 quickly.
